typescript.enable.title: Enable TypeScript Language Features
typescript.enable.description: Enable TypeScript language features for this workspace.

javascript.enable.title: Enable JavaScript Language Features
javascript.enable.description: Enable JavaScript language features (same TS server).

typescript.validate.enable.title: TypeScript: Validate
typescript.validate.enable.description: Enable semantic validation (errors/warnings) in TypeScript files.

javascript.validate.enable.title: JavaScript: Validate
javascript.validate.enable.description: Enable semantic validation in JavaScript files.

typescript.server.mode.title: Language Server Mode
enumDescriptions: Built-in TypeScript Web Worker (works in browser & mobile with multi-file workspace sync)
External typescript-language-server via Alpine (proot) / native terminal
typescript.server.mode.description: Choose between the built-in browser TypeScript Web Worker LSP or external typescript-language-server running in Alpine/native terminal.

typescript.tsserver.log.title: TS Server Log
typescript.tsserver.log.description: Logging level for the TypeScript server.

typescript.tsserver.maxTsServerMemory.title: Max TS Server Memory (MB)
typescript.tsserver.maxTsServerMemory.description: Maximum memory (MB) for the TypeScript server process.

typescript.tsserver.watchOptions.title: TS Server Watch Options
typescript.tsserver.watchOptions.description: Advanced file-watching options passed to tsserver.

typescript.tsserver.experimental.enableP.title: Project-wide Diagnostics
typescript.tsserver.experimental.enableP.description: Report diagnostics for the whole project (may use more CPU/memory).

typescript.tsdk.title: TypeScript SDK Path
typescript.tsdk.description: Path to a custom TypeScript install (folder containing lib/typescript.js). Empty = bundled/npm global.

typescript.locale.title: Locale
typescript.locale.description: Locale for TypeScript messages (e.g. en, ja). auto = editor locale.

typescript.disableAutomaticTypeAcquisiti.title: Disable Automatic Type Acquisition
typescript.disableAutomaticTypeAcquisiti.description: Do not auto-download @types packages for JS projects.

typescript.npm.title: npm Path
typescript.npm.description: Path to npm used for automatic type acquisition. Empty = PATH.

typescript.suggest.autoImports.title: Auto Imports
typescript.suggest.autoImports.description: Enable auto-import suggestions and add imports on completion.

typescript.suggest.completeFunctionCalls.title: Complete Function Calls
typescript.suggest.completeFunctionCalls.description: Complete function calls with parameter snippets.

javascript.suggest.completeFunctionCalls.title: Complete Function Calls
javascript.suggest.completeFunctionCalls.description: Complete function calls with parameter snippets.

typescript.suggest.objectLiteralMethodSn.title: Object Literal Method Snippets
typescript.suggest.objectLiteralMethodSn.description: Suggest method snippets inside object literals.

typescript.suggest.includeCompletionsFor.title: Import Statement Completions
typescript.suggest.includeCompletionsFor.description: Include completions for import paths and statements.

typescript.preferences.importModuleSpeci.title: Import Module Specifier
typescript.preferences.importModuleSpeci.description: Preferred style for auto-imports module specifiers.

typescript.preferences.importModuleSpeci.title: Import Module Specifier Ending
typescript.preferences.importModuleSpeci.description: Preferred path ending for imports (extension / index).

typescript.preferences.includePackageJso.title: Package.json Auto Imports
typescript.preferences.includePackageJso.description: Include dependencies from package.json in auto-imports.

typescript.preferences.quoteStyle.title: Quote Style
typescript.preferences.quoteStyle.description: Preferred quote style for auto-imports and refactors.

typescript.preferences.jsxAttributeCompl.description: How to complete JSX attribute values.

typescript.preferences.renameShorthandPr.title: Rename Shorthand Properties
typescript.preferences.renameShorthandPr.description: When renaming, update shorthand properties with prefix/suffix text.

typescript.preferences.useAliasesForRena.title: Use Aliases for Renames
typescript.preferences.useAliasesForRena.description: Prefer alias names when renaming across files.

typescript.preferences.autoImportFileExc.title: Auto Import File Exclude Patterns
typescript.preferences.autoImportFileExc.description: Glob patterns for files that should not appear in auto-import suggestions.

typescript.hover.enabled.title: Hover Enabled
typescript.hover.enabled.description: Show hover documentation and type info.

typescript.inlayHints.enabled.title: Inlay Hints Master Switch
typescript.inlayHints.enabled.description: Master switch for TypeScript inlay hints (requires editor.inlayHints.enabled).

typescript.inlayHints.parameterNames.ena.title: Parameter Name Hints
typescript.inlayHints.parameterNames.ena.description: Show parameter name inlay hints at call sites.

typescript.inlayHints.parameterNames.sup.title: Suppress Parameter Names When Matching
typescript.inlayHints.parameterNames.sup.description: Hide parameter name hint when the argument identifier matches the parameter name.

typescript.inlayHints.parameterTypes.ena.title: Parameter Type Hints
typescript.inlayHints.parameterTypes.ena.description: Show parameter type hints on function declarations.

typescript.inlayHints.variableTypes.supp.title: Suppress Variable Types When Matching Name
typescript.inlayHints.variableTypes.supp.description: Hide variable type hint when the type name matches the variable name.

typescript.inlayHints.propertyDeclaratio.title: Property Declaration Type Hints
typescript.inlayHints.propertyDeclaratio.description: Show type hints on property declarations.

typescript.inlayHints.functionLikeReturn.title: Function Return Type Hints
typescript.inlayHints.functionLikeReturn.description: Show return type hints on functions and methods.

typescript.inlayHints.enumMemberValues.e.title: Enum Member Value Hints
typescript.inlayHints.enumMemberValues.e.description: Show inferred values on enum members.

javascript.inlayHints.parameterNames.ena.title: Parameter Name Hints
javascript.inlayHints.parameterNames.ena.description: Parameter name inlay hints in JavaScript.

javascript.inlayHints.parameterTypes.ena.title: Parameter Type Hints
javascript.inlayHints.parameterTypes.ena.description: Parameter type hints in JavaScript (when types are known via JSDoc).

typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabl.title: Update Imports on File Move
typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabl.description: Update import paths when a file is moved or renamed.

typescript.reportStyleChecksAsWarnings.title: Report Style Checks as Warnings
typescript.reportStyleChecksAsWarnings.description: Report style checks (unreachable code, unused labels, …) as warnings.

typescript.surveys.enabled.title: Enable Surveys
typescript.surveys.enabled.description: Allow occasional TypeScript surveys (desktop VS Code parity; unused on mobile).

editor.inlayHints.enabled.title: Editor: Inlay Hints Enabled
editor.inlayHints.enabled.description: Editor-level inlay hints visibility (must be on for TS/JS hints to appear).
